title: Code Emission Check Protocol
description: Dual-gate enforcement protocol. Mechanical rules run via __check.sh. Semantic rules run via agent self-check. Code is not emitted until both gates pass.

mechanical.description: Rules checked by __check.sh shell script. Language-agnostic text checks.

semantic.description: Rules evaluated by the agent. Requires reasoning about code structure.

evaluationProtocol.description: For each semantic rule, the agent must produce a one-line verdict: PASS, WAIVED (with reason), or FIXED (with what changed). If any rule yields FAIL, the code must be fixed and both gates re-run.

sequence: 1. Write modified code to a .tmp file (never check against stale on-disk state)
3. Run semantic self-check against all 21 rules
4. If any violation remains: fix code, go to step 1
5. Only when both gates pass: overwrite target file, emit code

circuitBreaker.description: If the same violation persists after 3 correction attempts, halt. Emit the failing code, state the unresolved violation, and request human intervention.
circuitBreaker.onExhaustion: Emit code with [VERIFIED: BLOCKED] summary and unresolved violation details.

contextManagement.description: Drop failed intermediate reasoning traces from context. Only the final verified artifact and summary receipt survive in the active trace.

waiverProtocol.scoping: rule-scoped, not line-scoped. A waiver for TB-09 does not waive TB-10 on the same line.
waiverProtocol.persistence: Inline with code. Survives sessions. Dies when the code dies.
waiverProtocol.reEvaluation: Agent must re-evaluate waivers when surrounding code changes. If the justification no longer holds, flag it.

emissionContract.description: Every code block emitted by the agent MUST be immediately followed by this one-line summary. Code without a [VERIFIED] line is a protocol breach.
emissionContract.missingReceiptResponse: The user sees no receipt line — a human-detectable protocol breach.

fm1_infiniteLoop.scenario: Agent fails a check, fixes, fails again, loops.
fm1_infiniteLoop.mitigation: Circuit breaker: 3 attempts per violation, then halt.

fm2_ioDesync.scenario: Agent runs __check.sh on stale on-disk file while holding modified code in memory.
fm2_ioDesync.mitigation: Always write to .tmp first, check .tmp, overwrite target only on pass.

fm3_contextExhaustion.scenario: Multiple fix iterations fill context, agent forgets primitives.
fm3_contextExhaustion.mitigation: Drop failed intermediate traces. Only final artifact + summary survive.

fm4_regexCollision.scenario: grep flags valid literal string as forbidden token.
fm4_regexCollision.mitigation: Apply @waiver annotation. Accepted cost of parser-less checks.

fm5_skipCheck.scenario: Agent emits code without running check protocol.
fm5_skipCheck.mitigation: Missing [VERIFIED] line is human-detectable protocol breach.

fm6_malformedJson.mitigation: Agent must validate JSON before proceeding. Block emission on parse failure.

fm7_waiverRot.scenario: Waiver remains on code whose context has changed.
fm7_waiverRot.mitigation: Re-evaluate waivers when surrounding code changes.

fm8_semanticInconsistency.scenario: Same code, different sessions, different pass/fail on semantic rules.
fm8_semanticInconsistency.mitigation: Concrete evaluation criteria in each rule's check description.
